title: Check a disconnected auditor, a cancellation and an uncertain outcome live
goal: Bounded live checks show the cross-node placements keep privacy, leases and permission gates when the auditor disconnects, a run is cancelled or an outcome is uncertain
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures and the gauntlet packs only; local models on the enrolled NERV-01 and NERV-02 over Tailscale; 0 paid cloud tokens; raw reports stay in ~/.nerv-private on their base; NERV-01's live service (~/.nerv-app, ~/.nerv) is never stopped, updated or edited.
acceptance: Disconnected auditor: NERV on NERV-02 stopped during a bounded cross-node run; no fallback, clean degraded reason; NERV-02 restarted and confirmed healthy afterwards
Cancellation: a bounded cross-node run is cancelled; leases released and no effect applied
Uncertain outcome: a bounded run whose outcome cannot be confirmed is reported as uncertain, not as passed, and no permission gate is bypassed
validation: Recorded evidence for this slice; scoped checks and required CI
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
A stop rule of the placement campaign aborts the run without fallback or retry
Anything that needs a credential, an unreachable host or the owner goes back to the owner; NERV-02 is left running

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 (F-006-T22): three bounded probes on live bases with one NERV-02 stop and restart; owner allowed stopping NERV on NERV-02 only. Implemented 2026-11-24 in 0.5 h: Disconnected auditor (NERV-02 stopped 03:17, restarted 03:19, healthy), cancellation and uncertain outcome held on live bases; cancellation does not reach the Mac's generation.
